Prior review retained below:
Re-read the literal questions and reviewed direction, sources, counterevidence and metadata after completing all 15 axes. Corrected no-confidence/recall assumptions, SRG private-law ownership, prospective investment screening, marriage/adoption support, public-company loss response, official-secret publication, random alcohol checks and anticipatory force. Guy Parmelin is rotating president of a seven-member council, not a sole executive. Recent referendum outcomes and implemented measures were researched separately from proposals. Federal departments count as one primary publisher; AP, Freedom House, Amnesty, Council of Europe, OECD and others supply independent material. Thirteen unanswered questions remain after targeted follow-up: two Indigenous-specific questions, two invasive cognitive-implant questions and nine precise causal-psychology comparisons. Anti-racism and clinical interaction models are explicit limited inferences, not direct general heritability findings; Nature Q1/Q6/Q14/Q15 merit independent scrutiny. Further review should examine assimilation Q12/Q13, natural-resource ownership Q12 and cantonal-to-national generalisation. No comparison target or other country answers used. Commons File page, creators and public-domain notices checked; local 960px square PNG visually inspected, 658 bytes, no crop. Independent parent audit and similarity review pending. Validation on 4 October 2026 reports only the 13 deliberately unresolved answers as errors; the validator also labels unknown/null evidence as unscorable Neutral, although all are null rather than zero. Warnings for six immigration, six redistribution and five innovation Neutrals were checked as conditional or mixed policies. No neighbours are emitted for the incomplete draft. Separate completion challenge on 2026-10-05: checked exact wording, qualified magnitude, source scope and earlier withdrawal reasons for new estimates. Minority recognition is not Indigenous territorial jurisdiction, subgroup asylum preference is not country-wide preference, product oversight is not a healthy-implant-specific threshold, and learning interventions do not quantify general heredity. Neutral entries describe contextual interaction rather than missing evidence. Body-image studies are narrower than attraction and are not adopted government doctrine. Retained earlier detailed assessment reviews; no independent second-agent or human review is claimed. Newly flagged assumption IDs: assimilation-multiculturalism-06, innovation-caution-08, innovation-caution-11, central-local-13, culture-nature-02, culture-nature-03, culture-nature-05, culture-nature-07, culture-nature-08, culture-nature-10, culture-nature-11, culture-nature-12, culture-nature-13. All remaining null responses resolved under the owner-authorised educated-assumption rule; validation and generated output recorded separately. Read every neutral rationale on the validator-flagged axes in a separate warning pass. Swiss immigration describes EU/EFTA versus third-country rules; redistribution competing implemented entitlements and tax restraint; innovation sector-specific safeguards; causal traits interactive models. US liberty records scoped powers and judicial exceptions, ownership actual public/private combinations, and causal traits interaction. These were retained for substantive mixed evidence, not missing answers.
